items.title: Police killer Dezi Freeman had hundreds of child abuse files
items.description: Police killer Dezi Freeman was on the verge of having his secret stash of child abuse material discovered when he gunned down two officers outside his makeshift home.

items.title: Former ASIO chief raised questions about assessment of Bondi gunman
items.description: The former head of Australia's domestic intelligence agency questioned whether early assessments of Bondi Beach gunman Naveed Akram were sufficiently rigorous, while advising the royal commission examining the December terrorist attack.

items.title: Parents slam 'weak' school response after 21 girls targeted in deepfake scandal
items.description: Two parents of girls at a private school have criticised the institution's response to a deepfake incident, saying they were encouraged not to tell their daughters they had been identified in material shared in a boys' group chat.

items.title: Live: King Charles says 'acts of violence will never succeed' after attack on Trump
items.description: King Charles delivers a speech to Congress as part of his visit to the US to celebrate the 250th anniversary of American independence. Follow live.

items.title: What we know about the hours before a 5yo girl went missing in Alice Springs
items.description: Five-year-old Sharon Granites vanished from an Alice Springs town camp late on Saturday night, with police alleging she has been abducted. Here's what we know about the night she went missing.

items.title: Melbourne to Queensland exodus 'starting to see reversal' amid housing unaffordability
items.description: South-East Queensland has been under-represented in 5% Deposit Scheme approvals, with prospective first-home buyers heading to Melbourne for its "considerable affordability" benefits.

items.title: The 'double-headed monster' set to push up prices at the check-out
items.description: Companies that use plastic packaging are facing price pressures and supply disruptions, which they warn will likely mean higher costs for consumers. The cost of food-grade resin out of Singapore, which is used in milk bottles, has increased 110 per cent since the start of the Middle East war.

items.title: Does the gas industry pay its fair share of tax?
items.description: Advocates are proposing a flat 25 per cent tax on gas exports, but representatives say the industry is being unfairly targeted.

items.title: Industry experts speculate on oil refinery upgrades as budget day nears
items.description: As the international fuel crisis continues to cause concern, the federal government is under pressure to provide a fix during next month's budget.

items.title: Live: Trump says Iran in 'state of collapse', US marines board cargo ship
items.description: US President Donald Trump says Iranian leadership has told him they are in a "state of collapse" and are urging him to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, as US marines board cargo ships in the region and Israeli strikes kill three in Lebanon. Follow live.

items.title: Australia risks repeating social media mistakes with AI in workplace: report
items.description: Australia risks repeating the mistakes it made with social media unless it moves quickly to regulate the spread of artificial intelligence in the workplace, according to a new report.

items.title: 'Huge amount' of antibiotics at salmon farm concerning, say Greens, expert
items.description: Almost 3 tonnes of the antibiotic florfenicol were used at one Tasmanian salmon farm lease in just two months, with information on its use across eight other sites yet to be released to the public by authorities.

items.title: Dave doesn't know how he contracted the disease that cost him a liver and a kidney
items.description: An alarming new report has found liver cancer deaths have risen from 1.6 deaths per 100,000 people in the 1980s to 5.1 per 100,000 in 2018–2022.

items.title: Everything you need to know about this year's winter vaccine rollout
items.description: With winter just around the corner, now is the perfect time to get vaccinated against seasonal flu and other viruses.

items.title: Warwick Thornton didn't believe in sequels, until now
items.description: Convinced to return to the story of the 2018 outback drama Sweet Country, Kaytetye filmmaker Warwick Thornton fell in love with the possibilities.

items.title: I'm worried about my neighbour's dog. What should I do?
items.description: An unhappy dog doesn't necessarily mean criminal neglect, even if the level of care is below what you would give your own pet.

items.title: Travel quiz: Grab your ticket and a map, we're off on an adventure
items.description: The Galápagos Islands are part of which South American country? The Elgin Marbles were taken from which ancient site?

items.title: El Niño one step closer as Pacific transition now fastest in 50 years
items.description: Australia's weather pattern is in a reset, and the weather events happening this month will act like the ingredients to determine the flavour of our climate for the rest of the year.

items.title: Farrer voters speak up as pre-polling begins in blockbuster by-election
items.description: Pre-polling commences in the seat of Farrer for the hotly contested by-election triggered by the resignation of former opposition leader Sussan Ley.

items.title: 'Almost bullying': Private hospitals blame closures on 'cowboy' insurers
items.description: A former Bupa executive accuses health insurers of using "almost bullying" tactics in their negotiations with private hospitals, while the Australian Private Hospitals Association says insurers have become "cowboys" in need of regulation.

items.title: The soy sauce fish is a perfect design — except on one important point
items.description: Shoyu-tai, the single-use plastic soy sauce fish that accompany takeaway sushi, are an eco-nightmare — but a local designer has a solution.

items.title: Global defence spending hits record high. This is how countries rank
items.description: The world is spending more money on weapons than ever before, reaching nearly $4 trillion in 2025.

items.title: CCTV footage shows moment underworld figure Gavin Preston was shot dead
items.description: The Victorian Supreme Court has released footage of the moment underworld figure Gavin Preston was shot dead in Melbourne.

items.title: Alleged gunman, 89, arrested after injuring five in Athens shootings
items.description: The elderly man opened fire at a social security agency and then a courthouse in Athens before fleeing the scene, police say.

items.title: Jimmy Kimmel says joke misconstrued as Trumps call to fire late-night host
items.description: Donald Trump says Jimmy Kimmel should be fired for a monologue he delivered days before the third alleged attempt to assassinate the US president.
